title: Seaside Vacation Home Near Beach Access Sleeps 12
meta_description: 5BR Seaside vacation home for 12 with two king suites, wraparound porch, private driveway, and a short walk to beach access, pools, and downtown Seaside.
description_expanded: Welcome to Drift Away on Savannah Street in Seaside, FloridaSay hello to Drift Away, a beautifully reimagined coastal retreat located on charming Savannah Street in the heart of Seaside, Florida. Completely remodeled from top to bottom, this bright and cheerful home blends relaxed seaside style with modern comfort—making it an instant favorite for your next beach getaway. With coastal décor, sun-filled spaces, and a fun retro-inspired kitchen, Drift Away sets the tone for a carefree stay just moments from Seaside’s beaches and amenities.Prime Location Near the Beach & Seaside AmenitiesPerfectly positioned, Drift Away is just a short walk to Seaside’s private residential beach, swimming pools, tennis and pickleball courts, the fitness center, and the children’s park. Downtown Seaside’s shops, dining, and iconic landmarks are also easily accessible, allowing you to explore everything 30A has to offer without ever needing your car.Two Homes Combined for Space, Comfort & PrivacyDrift Away offers the unique advantage of combining Drift Away Main (four bedrooms) with Drift Away Suite (one bedroom) to create a spacious, five-bedroom accommodation. This layout is ideal for large families, multi-generational vacations, or two families traveling together—providing ample shared space while still allowing for privacy and flexibility.Inviting Outdoor Living SpacesGuests enter through a wrap-around screened-in porch that sets the stage for relaxed coastal living. Furnished with lounge seating and an outdoor dining table for four, this breezy porch is perfect for morning coffee, afternoon reading, or evening meals enjoyed al fresco under the Seaside sky.First-Floor Living, Dining & KitchensThe first floor is designed for gathering and entertaining, featuring two living areas, two dining areas, two fully equipped kitchens, and two full bathrooms (shower only). The primary living space at the front of the home includes an open-concept living room, dining area seating six, and a renovated kitchen with stainless steel appliances and a playful retro green refrigerator that adds classic beach-house charm. A four-burner electric stovetop and breakfast bar seating for three complete the space.Toward the rear of the home, a secondary living suite offers another full kitchen with bar seating for three, a dining table for four, and a cozy living area with a queen sleeper sofa—ideal for extended family or guests seeking extra independence.Comfortable Bedrooms for Groups of All SizesDrift Away comfortably accommodates guests across five bedrooms:First Floor: Queen bedroom, Twin bedroom (two twins), King bedroom at the rear of the home (These bedrooms share two full hall bathrooms (shower only))Second Floor: King bedroom, Twin bedroom (two twins) (Both upstairs bedrooms share a full bathroom with a shower)This thoughtful layout makes Drift Away especially well-suited for families with children or mixed-age groups.Shared Laundry & Additional DetailsAll Drift Away units, along with the neighboring Hide Away home, share a washer and dryer conveniently located beneath the stairwell at Hide Away.With its fresh renovation, flexible layout, and unbeatable Savannah Street location, Drift Away delivers the space, comfort, and classic Seaside charm needed for a memorable 30A vacation—whether you’re traveling with one family or two.This home may also be rented as Drift Away Main (4-bedroom) home or a Drift Away Suite (1-bedroom) during Fall, Winter, or Spring only. There is also a separate carriage house, Hide Away, which is a 1 bedroom stand alone guest home avaialbe for rent separately in addition to Drift Away if you need more room.There is shared driveway parking for this unit. The carriage house, Hide Away may also be occupied at the same time, and guests will have first come/first served driveway parking.5-night minimum Spring, Spring Break and Summer; 5-night minimum Fall; 3-night minimum Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration. *Please be advised that neighboring properties may currently be undergoing construction or renovation during your stay. As a result, intermittent noise or construction-related activity may occur at certain times throughout the day. This work is managed by third parties outside of our control, and we appreciate your understanding while enjoying the property. For additional questions or concerns regarding nearby construction activity, please contact Homeowner’s Collection at 1-855-411-1557.FEATURES2,507 Square Feet of thoughtfully designed living space, ideal for large families or shared group staysSeaside Private Residential Beach Access at Savannah Pavilion3-Minute Walk to the Beach (approximately 176 yards)New Smart TVs with Roku throughout the homeEnhanced Wi-Fi System for reliable connectivityPeacock Alley Linens – Fresh and luxurious Peacock Alley towels and sheets throughout the homeShared Washer & Dryer – All Drift Away units and the Hide Away home share one washer/dryer located under the stairwell at Hide AwaySeaside Amenities Access including 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts (court fees apply), 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome Tote Included with 2 beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and 2 complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized Guest Services provided throughout your stay with starter amenities includedParking Information – Two parking passes issued for two-bedroom and larger homes; golf carts are considered vehicles and are prohibited for non-homeowners unless approved for medical needsNo Pets AllowedSTR23-001912
